_about: Anti-invention (Matt, 2026-09-28: 'we somehow want to ensure what is created is not invented vs the style we look for'). Every visual element Comic B may use, each with its citation in the reference pages (wiki/image-library/assets/originals/comic-references/, crop boxes [left, top, width, height] in source pixels) or Matt's dated exception. The deslop lint fails anything used in the code or the stories that is not listed here ('invented: <x>'). Add an element only with a citation or a spec paragraph.

font:Kalam Letter.measure: Kalam 700 (SIL OFL, site/public/fonts/kalam-700.woff2, OFL-kalam.txt): chosen by Matt, 2026-09-30 ('Kalam lettering'), from the 15 px comparison beside the reference crops (wiki/image-library/assets/experiments/comic-b/browser-shots/font-candidates-15px.png) as the closest compact, forward-leaning pen hand. Stress is the same face slanted further (Kalam has no italic; a synthetic 12deg slant, lettering:bold-italic-stress).

Applies to every illustrated comic including demo. Existing caption lettering/rule and alpha 0.85 preserved; sceneSetup semantic marker selects measured bottom-right placement.
